Class SysMLStakeholder

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.items.SysMLItem
sysmlinjava.parts.SysMLPart
sysmlinjava.parts.SysMLStakeholder
All Implemented Interfaces:
StateBehaviorContext
public abstract class SysMLStakeholder extends SysMLPart
SysMLinJava representation of the SysML stakeholder. The SysMLStakeholder is a specialized SysMLPart that specifies the stakeholder's name and a list of concerns associated with the stakeholder.

SysMLStakeholder is used by the @SysMLRequirement and SysMLViewpoint. Instances of the SysMLStakeholder should be declared in extensions of the SysMLRequirements and SysMLViewPoints class. See those classes for more info on how to declare the SysMLStakeholder instances.

  • Method Details

    • createConcerns

      protected void createConcerns()
      Creates the concerns associated with this stakeholdr. Concerns must be created/initialized as references to SysMLConcern instances in extensions of SysMLConcernCollections. An example follows: 
              public class UserStakeholder extends SysMLStakeholder
        {
                @Concern
                SysMLConcern usabilityConcern;
                @Concern
                SysMLConcern performanceConcern;
                @Concern
                SysMLConcern qualityConcern;
                        :
                @Override
                protected void createConcerns()
                {
                        usabilityConcern = SystemConcerns.usabilityConcern;
                        performanceConcern = SystemConcerns.performanceConcern;
                        qualityConcern = SystemConcerns.qualityConcerns;
                }
                        :
        }
